name: Do I need a permit to replace sliding windows in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to replace sliding windows in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for window replacement can vary by city and the scope of the project. In Daly City, replacing existing windows with new ones of the same size and type often does not require a building permit, provided there are no structural modifications. However, if you are changing the size or location of a window, altering a load-bearing wall, or performing extensive structural work, a permit will likely be necessary. It's always advisable to confirm with the City of Daly City Building Division or consult with your contractor, City Dweller, LLC, who can help determine specific permit needs for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Daly City, replacing windows of the same size and type often doesn't require a permit, but structural changes usually do. Confirm with the Building Division or your contractor.
